verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships an official, npm-published Editor MCP server that lets AI agents connect to an open Editor session, modify project data, and verify results, plus a separate documented scriptable Editor API (api.playcanvas.com/editor) for programmatic scene/node/property manipulation and automation. This directly satisfies the story of an agent driving the editor programmatically through a documented interface. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community report of an agent actually using the MCP server end-to-end, and no explicit documentation of triggering builds via this interface.
